other_conditions: Startups must be defined and recognized by the Department of Industrial Policy Promotion (DIPP) of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India
Any Indian company incorporated under the Companies Act 1956/2013, primarily a Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise (MSME) as defined in the MSME Act, 2006, is eligible
Individual innovators (including research and academic institutions) are eligible but must form a start‑up before signing the SPARK Grant Agreement
benefits_summary: Provides grants up to Rs 1.5 crore (up to Rs 10 crore for iDEX Prime) to startups/MSMEs for defence technology projects.
